deadline.value: Funding deadline January 6, 2027 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: Direct PhD applications need a named supervisor; the DTP-MR route instead uses lab rotations with no named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Direct PhD applications to supervisors within the Department of Medicine will not be accepted without a named supervisor.

funding.value: No course-specific funding; applicants are encouraged to seek independent funding such as Gates Cambridge.
funding.quote: Applicants pursuing this route are encouraged to explore independent funding opportunities

entry_route.value: A good II.i honours degree (or international equivalent) is the stated standard; no master's is stated.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for this course should have achieved a Good II.i Honours Degree.

notes: Other biomedical PhDs (Pathology, Pharmacology, Cancer Biology and others) are separate courses.
